name: ClearCut AI Browser Studio
description: Free, 100% private client-side WebAssembly AI background remover and precision edge studio.

tools.name: get_studio_state
tools.description: Returns current ClearCut AI studio navigation route, active tab (editor or batch), image processing status, and batch queue count.

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: Lists all 10 ClearCut AI background removal workflow pages and built-in sample image IDs.

tools.name: navigate_workflow
tools.description: Navigates to one of the 10 ClearCut AI background removal workflow routes.

tools.name: open_batch_queue
tools.description: Switches the studio directly to the multi-image Batch Queue and ZIP export view.

tools.name: run_sample_background_removal
tools.description: Loads one of the built-in sample images and immediately runs client-side AI background removal.

tools.name: reset_studio
tools.description: Clears the active studio image and returns to the upload dropzone.
